target_customer: E-commerce brands and go to market teams that want AI agents for growth and creative work
problem: Marketing teams spend heavy effort on creative, ads and growth checks; Goose agents read ad, store and email data to find revenue leaks and produce content.
business_model: Custom priced tiers (Starter, Growth, Business) for an AI growth agent

founders.name: Himanshu Bamoria
previous_startups: Athina AI (LLM evaluation platform, YC W23)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he scaled an earlier startup from zero to 8M revenue

founders.name: Shiv Sakhuja
previous_startups: Athina AI (LLM evaluation platform, YC W23)
founders.background_notes: Troops.ai was acquired by Salesforce per YC page; American Bazaar quotes him as co-founder and CEO of Athina

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that connect to ad and store APIs and learn from performance data are standard LLM engineering, with integration breadth as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Context indexing and integrations add some lock in, but many AI agent and marketing tools offer similar workflows.

market_need_then: The W23 company was Athina AI, built for the 2023 wave of LLM application builders who needed evaluation and monitoring. Goose targets the later agent era.

identity.mascot_or_character: Goose, the agent is called Goose
identity.voice_and_tone: Outcome focused, quantifies revenue at stake per finding

rebrands.why: Athina evolved into Gooseworks per a search summary; reason not sourced

branding.community_and_virality: Founder Shiv Sakhuja has a content creator following per YC page; no merch evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage brand with little press found about the brand itself.

pivots.from: Athina AI, LLM evaluation and observability
pivots.to: Gooseworks AI marketing and growth agents
pivots.why: Not sourced; positioning also shifted from AI video ad creative to e-commerce growth agent to GTM AI coworkers

outcome_analysis: The W23 batch company was Athina AI, which raised a 3 million seed in November 2024, and the same founders now run Gooseworks, which the YC page describes as an AI marketing agent company with five people. Positioning has changed more than once. Funding for Gooseworks itself is not public, so the outcome is unclear and no strong story can be drawn.
notes: Athina AI raised a 3M seed in 2024-11 (YourStory, Inc42, American Bazaar) and earlier pre-seed (Flourish Ventures, GSF India per Inc42); these belong to Athina and it is not confirmed they carried over to Gooseworks, so no rounds are recorded. Aggregators list 4.1M and 20K totals which conflict. No dated competitor sources were found for the batch era; a search on LLM observability tools returned only 2024 to 2026 guides. Education for both founders not found.
